jobs.description: Natural Cycles is a regulated medical device company that markets like a consumer brand, which is exactly what makes the creative work here harder and better. We are rebuilding the brand to match the science, launching our first wearables, and doing it with a creative team that is being rebuilt at the same time. You are the senior art direction craft in that team: the person who takes a brief and comes back with a point of view, sets the visual bar on the work you touch, and makes the brand hold together across a campaign film, a carousel and a packaging insert. This is a senior individual contributor seat. You set the standard through the work rather than through a reporting line.Please note: this role is open only to candidates who already live on the U.S. East Coast or in Stockholm, Sweden. We are not able to offer relocation support. What you will be doing    Art-direct campaign and brand work from concept to production-ready across film, digital, social, out-of-home, packaging and event.    Lead the visual execution of product launches, working from the brand platform rather than restating it each time.    Make brand and performance push in the same direction: develop work that holds the brand standard and earns its place in a test.    Build systems, not only assets — templates, components, type and grid behaviour, chart and graphic styles that stay coherent as volume grows and more hands touch them.    Direct external partners: photographers, directors, illustrators, retouchers, production and agency teams, and localisation partners adapting work for individual markets.    Work with Product Design and Writing so the brand does not change character at the app boundary.    Use AI tooling as part of daily production — motion, variation, concepting — and have a view on where it fails.    Work inside medical device and advertising constraints, and partner with Regulatory early enough that review is fast rather than adversarial.What skills and experience we think you have    8+ years in art direction or design, with a portfolio of integrated work — not a single channel — that performed as well as it looked.    Evidence of range: a brand idea carried across formats, from a hero moment down to a paid unit.    Systems thinking. Has built templates and components other people actually used.    Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud; working motion ability, with After Effects or equivalent.    Proven quick turnarounds without a drop in craft.    Comfort working inside a regulated health brand, including Legal and Regulatory review rounds.    Health, wellness or femtech experience is an advantage, as is illustration or 3D for launch moments.    Currently based on the U.S. East Coast, or in Stockholm, Sweden.What we offer    Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team spread across the U.S. East Coast and Sweden that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location    Professional development - you will work alongside knowledgeable colleagues in the continuous growth and skill enhancement environment    Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work    Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value    Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development LocationWe are a remote-friendly company, and we also value connecting in person. The team you will be working with are spread across Sweden and the U.S., and for this role we are looking for someone currently based either on the U.S. East Coast, or in Stockholm, Sweden.Salary bracket: $100,000 - $150,000 per year, annual bonus aligned with the Company’s Bonus Policy. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's skills, experience, and qualifications.This range may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will fall toward the starting point of the range, compensation will depend on the candidate's specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role's requirements.How to applyTo apply, just upload your CV and answer the questions on the application form. Keep in mind that we can't accept applications through email because of GDPR, and only applications submitted via the career site (and in English) will be considered.Equal OpportunityNatural Cycles is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the users we serve. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic.Natural Cycles participates in e-verify. E-verify provides the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Company description:Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent. We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.Job description:   Join Lynk & Co Europe, powered by Volvo Cars’ commercial network   Lynk & Co is entering an exciting new phase in Europe. From January 2027, Volvo Cars will become its exclusive European distributor, creating a new commercial set-up that combines Volvo Cars’ established infrastructure with Lynk & Co’s bold and distinctive brand. Employed by Volvo Cars and working closely with Lynk & Co, you’ll have the opportunity to help build this new chapter from the ground up and contribute to the brand’s continued growth across Europe.     What you'll do   As a Warranty Specialist, you will be part of the Warranty team within Aftersales, supporting our European workshop and retailer network. You will play a key role in our daily warranty operations by assessing warranty claims, supporting workshops and retailers, and ensuring that warranty decisions are accurate, consistent and aligned with applicable warranty policies and technical requirements. The role combines technical and financial claim assessment with workshop support, warranty cost control, data analysis and the recovery of eligible warranty costs from manufacturing plants, suppliers and other responsible parties. You will also contribute to the continuous improvement of warranty processes, claim quality and workshop support across European operations. •    Review and assess warranty claims submitted by workshops and make decisions within delegated authority.•    Verify claim eligibility, technical diagnosis, repair information, labour operations, parts usage, costs and supporting documentation.•    Use Lynk & Co technical information and relevant systems, including Codiac, to support consistent and evidence-based warranty decisions.•    Assess whether repairs and parts replacements are technically justified and appropriately documented.•    Provide clear and constructive guidance to workshops and retailers on warranty requirements, claim corrections and required documentation.•    Identify recurring claim-quality issues, unusual cost patterns and potential product-quality concerns.•    Prepare and follow up cases for warranty cost recovery from manufacturing plants, suppliers and other responsible parties.•    Coordinate warranty-related parts returns and provide relevant warranty information to Quality and other stakeholders.•    Analyse claim trends, cost deviations and workshop patterns, and contribute to warranty reporting and KPI follow-up.•    Maintain accurate and traceable warranty documentation and contribute to audits where required.•    Contribute to continuous improvements in warranty processes, working methods and workshop guidance.   Success in the role is measured through the quality, consistency and efficiency of warranty claim handling, timely workshop support, accurate documentation, effective warranty cost control, successful recovery of eligible warranty costs and contribution to the continuous improvement of Warranty operations.     What you'll bring   •    Relevant experience in automotive warranty, aftersales, technical support, claims handling or a comparable field.•    Good understanding of automotive repair processes and workshop operations.•    Ability to accurately assess technical and financial information.•    Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.•    Ability to interpret warranty policies, procedures and technical documentation.•    Good digital skills and confidence working across multiple systems.•    Good written and verbal communication skills in English.•    Ability to manage multiple cases and priorities effectively.•    Ability to make objective, consistent and well-documented decisions.•    Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team. Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:•    Automotive manufacturer, importer, national sales company or authorised workshop network.•    Automotive warranty or claim-management systems.•    Codiac or comparable automotive technical and support systems.•    Workshop support, warranty cost recovery or warranty data analysis.•    Microsoft Power BI or similar reporting and analytics tools.

What you bring•    A law degree with a specialisation in intellectual property and at least two years of experience in a law firm or equivalent IP environment.•    An understanding of SEPs and FRAND licensing principles.•    Excellent written and spoken English.•    The ability to translate complex legal and technical concepts into accessible, persuasive messages.•    An interest in communication and marketing, with an eye for clarity and audience engagement.•    A structured, proactive and collaborative approach.•    A Master's or PhD in IP or a related field, and experience writing policy or industry papers, are an advantage.

Company description:At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.Job description:Shape competitive high-voltage cable solutions for the energy transitionDo you want to take technical ownership of complex tenders and help shape high-voltage cable systems that enable the transition to renewable energy? As a Tender Lead Engineer at NKT, you will translate customer requirements and tender strategy into compliant and executable HVAC and HVDC cable system solutions. You will combine advanced engineering with technical leadership and customer interaction, working across disciplines and functions in an international environment. This is an opportunity to support key technical decisions at an early stage, contribute directly to NKT’s business growth and work with critical power infrastructure supporting the expansion and interconnection of power grids. Manage engineering from tender strategy to technical solutionAs Tender Lead Engineer, you will take end-to-end technical ownership of assigned tenders, from requirement analysis and solution development through technical submission, clarification and handover. Acting as the technical focal point, you will coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities and ensure the proposed cable system balances technical performance, manufacturability, installation constraints, qualification, risk, cost and schedule. Key responsibilities include:•    Coordinate the complete technical scope and engineering activities of assigned tenders•    Develop and optimize HVAC and HVDC cable system solutions•    Translate requirements and standards into design premises and engineering deliverables•    Manage technical risks, deviations, qualifications and opportunities•    Lead technical customer dialogues, clarifications and negotiations The position is primarily based in Karlskrona but Malmö, Västerås or Rotterdam may also be considered. Regular collaboration across NKT locations is expected, with travel for customer meetings, internal collaboration and tender activities when required. A technical leader with a commercial mindsetYou thrive in a complex technical environment where ownership, structure and collaboration are key. You communicate clearly, build trust and stay focused when priorities shift. You are comfortable working across teams and locations, and you enjoy bringing people together to reach clear decisions. In addition, we believe you bring:•    M.Sc. or Ph.D. in electrical engineering or another relevant engineering discipline, or equivalent technical experience•    Relevant experience in tender engineering, project engineering, cable system design, power transmission or a comparable technically complex industry•    Demonstrated ability to manage and coordinate multidisciplinary technical work with responsibility for scope, quality and deadlines•    Demonstrated capability in requirement analysis, technical documentation and structured risk-based decision-making•    Fluency in spoken and written English•    Experience with high-voltage cable systems, relevant standards, qualification or installation interfaces is an advantage Lead engineering for tomorrow’s energy infrastructureNKT is committed to fostering a diverse organization and a culture where people from different backgrounds can thrive and are inspired to perform at their best. We believe that a diverse organization enables sustainable performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture makes for a better place to work. At NKT, you will work at the intersection of engineering, customer needs and commercial strategy, gaining broad exposure to high-voltage cable systems and international tender projects. You will collaborate with specialists across engineering and other functions while developing both your technical leadership and commercial understanding. Your work will contribute directly to cable solutions that support renewable energy integration, power grid expansion and the electrification of society. Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here! We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 2026-12-21. An extract from the criminal record, alcohol- and drug tests, medical tests along with personality tests, will be part of our recruitment process. At Sandvik Rock Tools in Sandviken, we're exploring how industrial sensor data can provide earlier and more reliable insight into machine conditions. This thesis combines practical measurements on production equipment with signal processing, data analysis, and AI to establish a reusable approach for future condition-monitoring initiatives. Background and purpose Modern production equipment generates many signals, but existing machine data is not always reliable or sampled at the frequency required for condition assessment. Additional sensors may be needed to capture vibration, temperature, acoustic, electrical, pressure, or other process-related phenomena.  The purpose of this thesis is to evaluate suitable sensors and data-collection methods, then analyze data from selected equipment using statistical and AI-based methods. The result should support further development of condition monitoring, diagnostics, and data-driven maintenance at Rock Tools. Work description The thesis is carried out as a structured proof of concept. Together with the company supervisor, you refine the scope, machine case, and success criteria. The work is expected to include:     Review relevant research on industrial condition monitoring, sensor selection, signal processing, and AI methods.     Define machine states, operating conditions, potential failure modes, and evaluation criteria.     Evaluate sensors and data-acquisition solutions based on sampling rate, installation, synchronization, robustness, accessibility and cost.     Plan and perform data collection, documenting sensor placement, machine settings and data quality.     Clean, synchronize and analyze time-series data using suitable time, frequency or time-frequency features.     Develop and compare statistical baselines and AI models for classification or anomaly detection.     Validate performance, including false alarms, missed detections, changing operating conditions, explainability and uncertainty.     Recommend sensors, an architecture aligned with the Sandvik Rock Tools Unified Namespace, a modelling approach and next steps. Expected deliverables are a sensor and data-acquisition concept, a quality-checked dataset, reproducible analysis and model code, a comparison of methods and a roadmap for continued development. The objective is a robust proof of concept and reusable method, not a production-ready predictive-maintenance platform.   Your profile We're looking for one or two analytical and hands-on students with an interest in industrial equipment, measurement technology, and data science. You work systematically, document decisions, and connect model results to physical machine behavior. Your background includes:     Ongoing Master’s studies in automation, mechatronics, mechanical or electrical engineering, engineering physics, computer science, industrial data science or a related field.     Experience with Python and data analysis.      An understanding of, or motivation to learn, time-series analysis, signal processing, machine learning and experimental design.       Good communication skills in English; Swedish is advantageous.  Experience with vibration analysis, industrial sensors, OPC UA, MQTT, PLC/CNC data or condition monitoring is advantageous, as is Knowledge of NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow. Our culture At Sandvik, we work with advanced technology and exciting innovations, but our people are the key to our success. We believe diversity and inclusion create stronger results through mutual support, knowledge sharing and different perspectives. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.  Scope The thesis corresponds to 30 ECTS credits and approximately 20 weeks of full-time work. The start date is agreed with the selected student or students and the university.  The position is based at Rock Tools in Sandviken, Sweden, with access to relevant equipment, data and supervision. Confidentiality, data handling and publication boundaries will be agreed at the start of the project. Contact information For more information, please contact Andreas Nelson, Method Development, at Tools, andreas.nelson@sandvik.comWe’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter. Application Please submit your application by December 13, 2026. Attach your CV, cover letter and transcript of records. Describe your experience with sensor data, signal processing, machine learning or industrial equipment, and what interests you most about the project. Applications by email are not accepted. Job ID: R0099692. Sandvik is a global, high-tech engineering group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability and sustainability in the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. Our offering includes equipment, tools, services and digital solutions for machining, mining, rock excavation, crushing and screening.
